name: larkspur-dispatch-basics
description: Golden tasks a dispatch assistant must always get right (deterministic answers).

golden_tasks.goal: What is 17 multiplied by 23? Reply with the number only.
Convert 2.5 kilometres to metres. Reply with the number only.
Reverse the letters of the word LARKSPUR. Reply with the reversed word only.
Sort these shipment ids in ascending order and reply comma-separated: SHP-9, SHP-2, SHP-5
How many days does February have in a leap year? Reply with the number only.
Write the word consignment in upper case. Reply with the word only.
What is the ISO 4217 currency code of the Indian rupee? Reply with the code only.
One pallet weighs 640 kg. How many kg do 5 such pallets weigh? Reply with the number only.
Which is the largest of 482, 1290 and 977? Reply with the number only.
What day of the week was 1 January 2026? Reply with the weekday only.

edit_for_v2.goal: What is 19 multiplied by 23? Reply with the number only.
